info.title: BitOasis Public API
info.description:
BitOasis Technologies is the Middle East & North Africa’s (MENA) largest online digital currency platform. Established in 2015, BitOasis operates from the United Arab Emirates (UAE) and currently aims its services at retail clients from the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) region, with plans to expand to the rest of the MENA market in the future. The services currently offered by BitOasis are as follows:

+ A Bitcoin (BTC) wallet with multi-signature technology for long term storage of Bitcoin (BTC).

+ A platform for basic buying/selling of digital currencies (referred to as the “BitOasis Core”).

+ A platform for trading in digital currencies (referred to as the “BitOasis Pro”).
+ A platform that facilitates sending and receiving digital currencies.

+ A platform that facilitates online and offline storage of clients’ digital assets.


The only services available for the public API are:

+ Trading in digital currencies (referred to as the “BitOasis Pro”).

+ Sending and receiving digital currencies.


And we are planning to provide a public API for the rest of the services in the near future.

tags.name: Base URL
tags.description:
**The base URL of the API**: `https://api.bitoasis.net/v1/`

The **V1** in URL is API version identifier. Right now we have only API version one.

Please follow the convention and use URIs without last trailing slash.

These are correct URIs
  + resource/11  `correct`
  + resource  `correct`

While the following examples are incorrect
  + resource/11/  `incorrect`
  + resource/  `incorrect`

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description:
To be able to access the API, you have to be a verified BitOasis user, you can verify your account from [here](https://bitoasis.net/en/verification).

To be able to utilize the BitOasis Public API, an access token must be generated by following the steps below:
  + Sign up to BitOasis and make sure to verify your account for Tier 1 as a minimum requirement or login to your existing verified account
  + Proceed to Settings > [API Token Management page](https://bitoasis.net/en/settings/tokens)
  + Click on the `+ Add Token` button
  + Enter a Name for the token (for your reference only)
  + Enter the IP address(es) you wish to allow to access your account (Can be blank to allow any IP address)
  + Determine the permissions you want to allow for the generated token by checking the boxes
  + Click on `Create Token`
  + After OTP verification the generated API token will appear for you. Please make sure to copy the token as is will not show after you click on `Confirm`

The token must be added to the request header with the parameter name `Authorization`. See below example:

`Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_API_TOKEN}`
